title: Java/Web Developer
description:
About Us
We're building a nationwide network of crowdsourced commercial real estate databases. Our wild start-up days are behind us - we're all grown up and profitable now with a 14-year track record and tens of thousands of clients that love us.
Within our small team, you'll be doing a little bit of everything:

• Building and maintaining server-side frameworks and APIs

• Adding and refining front-end features (JSP, JavaScript, JQuery, HTML5)

• If you're into it, configuring and managing parts of our stack (JBoss/Wildfly, MySQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch/ELK, salt)

About You
Like us, you value stability, work/life balance, group decisions, and working with people that are good-natured, interesting, hard-working, and self-motivated.
You're a quick study, have some experience using Java to build web applications, and aren't afraid of the command line.

Catylist is for you if...

• You hate the corporate bureaucracy of a big company.

• You're so over the chaos and uncertainty of a start-up. You like having reasonable hours and knowing that your job will be around next week.

• Consulting/freelance is not your bag. You prefer to maintain and improve the products you've built rather than hand them off and move on.

This is a full-time, 40 hours per week, remote, W2 position with benefits (health/dental/vision/401k).

When applying, please take some time and explain why you're a fit for our team, and please include your resume, github link, and anything else that will help us understand how awesome you are.

title: Oregon | Mental Health Therapist | Telehealth
description:
Telehealth Mental Health Therapist - Remote
Please note: This is a state-specific application. If you are not currently licensed in Oregon , we encourage you to visit www.affect.com to view our active openings by state.
If you do not see a current opportunity in your state, we still welcome you to submit your information through our General Application for Future Openings , also available on our website. We’d love to keep your details on file for future consideration.
About Affect Building on our success in substance use disorder care, Affect has expanded its services to include high-quality, accessible mental health treatment. Our model brings together licensed therapists, innovative technology, and a deeply human approach to help people manage anxiety, depression, trauma, and other mental health challenges-on their terms.
As we grow, we’re seeking skilled, compassionate licensed mental health professionals to join our remote care team. If you're an Oregon licensed LCSW, LMFT, LPC, or LPC Associate looking to make an impact through virtual care, we’d love to connect. (LPC Associates must reside in Oregon) .
Our ability to provide supervision for non-independent mental health professionals varies by state and license, but we also encourage you to apply. We try to support non-independent licenses when possible.
Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct diagnostic assessments and collaboratively develop evidence-based treatment plans

• Provide individual psychotherapy sessions via secure telehealth platforms

• Support Members with a wide range of mental health needs, including anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship challenges with flexibility to work with members with substance use disorders at times.

• Maintain clear and timely clinical documentation in our electronic medical record (EMR) system. Affect provides an AI-powered clinical scribe to assist with documentation, helping reduce administrative burden and allowing clinicians to spend more time focused on member care.

• Coordinate care as needed and contribute to a supportive, multidisciplinary environment

• Participate in clinical team meetings and optional case consultations

• Adhere to HIPAA and all applicable state licensure regulations

Requirements:

• Active, unrestricted Oregon license as an LCSW, LMFT, LPC, or LPC Associate (LPC Associates must reside in Oregon) . Applicants who reside outside of Oregon must also hold an active, unrestricted license in their state of residence. All licenses will be verified through the applicable State Licensing Board as part of the application process.

• Experience providing psychotherapy in outpatient, private practice, or telehealth settings

• Strong communication and clinical skills with a person-centered, trauma-informed approach

• Comfort with EMRs, Google Suite or Microsoft Office, and telehealth tools

• Ability to work independently in a remote setting with professionalism and integrity

• Have a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace and reliable internet

The Benefits of Joining Affect

• The salary range for this full-time position is $60,000 - $80,000 and will commensurate with experience and professional license.

• Full-time employees may enroll in offered medical, dental, and vision coverage and employer paid life and disability insurance also provided. Employees may enroll in Affect 's company’s 401k plan.

• Paid vacation, sick time, company observed holidays and parental leave is provided to full-time employees.

• Remote work options with full-time and part-time schedules

• AI-powered clinical scribe technology to streamline documentation and reduce administrative workload

• Opportunities for continuing education and professional development

• Supportive team culture focused on impact, collaboration, and innovation

• Be part of building a modern, inclusive, and accessible mental health care system

Join us as we expand our mission-empowering recovery, healing, and hope through digital-first mental health

• understanding of composition, texture, and color - and how to bring food to life on camera

title: Eating Disorder Specialist (Adolescent)
description:
Role Title: Eating Disorder Specialist (Adolescent)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Eating Disorder Specialist (Adolescent)s to contribute to a customer’s project focused on complex adolescent eating disorder cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Review and assess adolescent eating disorder cases, providing detailed written evaluations of clinical and medical risks.

• Apply DSM-5 criteria and validated screening tools (e.g., EDE-Q, SCOFF) to accurately characterize clinical presentations.

• Determine medical stability and identify cases requiring urgent escalation using recognized frameworks such as MEED.

• Evaluate appropriateness of treatment modalities (e.g., FBT, CBT-E) in relation to the adolescent’s clinical stage.

• Identify comorbidities and safeguarding concerns that may influence severity or required intervention.

• Produce clear, actionable guidance suitable for non-specialists, grounded in current clinical standards and guidelines.

• Benchmark clinical judgments against peers and established guidelines to ensure consistency and quality.

Preferred Qualifications

• 3-5+ years post-qualification experience working directly with adolescent patients in a clinical setting.

• Specialist background in eating disorders, child/adolescent psychiatry or psychology, or adolescent/paediatric medicine with a focus on eating disorders.

• Active clinical license or registration in good standing.

• Recent experience managing an adolescent caseload, or actively practicing within the past two years.

• Proficiency with evidence-based assessment tools (DSM-5, EDE-Q, SCOFF) and diagnostic frameworks.

• Familiarity with medical risk assessment protocols (e.g., MEED) and interventions such as FBT or CBT-E.

• Excellent written English skills (native, or equivalent to IELTS 7.5+/writing 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, Cambridge C1-C2).

• Desirable: Experience in medical stabilization for adolescents, formal FBT or CBT-E training, or expertise in co-occurring conditions such as self-harm or anxiety.

Start Timeline & Availability
We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24 - 48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: Sales Development - ANZ
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) based in Australia, at ElevenLabs you will play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives.

We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology.

In this role you will:

- Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market.

title: Senior Data Analyst - B2B
description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

MEET THE TEAM!

This role is embedded within either the B2B domain and is part of Preply’s Data Chapter. You will work closely with directors, B2B leaders, and cross-functional partners across finance and product teams, while collaborating with data analysts, data scientists, and analytics engineers to strengthen analytical foundations and business impact.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:  

- Partner with senior stakeholders across Business and Operations to proactively identify where new analyses, metrics, or frameworks can unlock improvements in retention, revenue, and operational efficiency.

- Build and own the analytical framework leadership uses to evaluate B2B trade-offs, and define the long-term measurement framework that identifies structural growth levers, not just incremental wins.

- Lead high-complexity, end-to-end analytical initiatives - including retention and cohort analyses that answer specific open questions from B2B leadership - uncovering root causes behind revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, and cost efficiency, and turning findings into concrete pricing, product, or lifecycle recommendations.

- Own impact modeling, scenario analysis, and KPI governance for B2B: resolve conflicting metric definitions across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Product, maintain a single source of truth, and feed directly into quarterly and annual planning.

- Design the experimentation and analytics agenda, what gets tested, how success is measured, and translate results into executive-ready storytelling that aligns stakeholders on goals and trade-offs.

- Partner with Directors and VPs to shape B2B strategy, embed analytics into daily decision-making, and mentor senior analysts to raise the analytical bar.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

- 5+ years of experience in analytics roles (ideally in B2B), with demonstrated ownership of KPI frameworks and measurable impact on retention, revenue, or efficiency.

- You can point to specific decisions (a pricing change, a resourcing call, a roadmap cut) that happened because of your analysis, and one where your recommendation was rejected, with the judgment to explain why, in hindsight, that was right or wrong.

- You've owned a metric or strategic framework other teams were required to use, and resolved a conflict between two teams who each wanted a different definition to win.

- Deep understanding of retention and performance metrics (revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, cost efficiency), and the ability to build an LTV or cohort model from scratch, not just interpret one someone else built.

- Strong, independent SQL, you're the person other analysts send their code to for review; proven ability to lead cross-functional analytical projects end-to-end.

- Strong business acumen and stakeholder influence: comfortable saying no to a request that wasn't the right question, clarifying trade-offs in metrics and resourcing, and building forecast or scenario models that leadership uses to defend a bet to their own leadership.

NICE TO HAVE:

- Background in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or account-based busin

description:

• Business Systems Analyst II: $60,000 - $74,000

• 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.

• Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.

Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.
This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings

New team members typically ramp on a smaller set of less complex centers first, then take on larger, higher-volume centers as they build expertise.

• Support new contact center initiatives from inception - for example, if the team rolls out new Amazon Connect functionality - partnering with technical teams on the underlying infrastructure considerations.

• Contribute to expanding the team's use of automated testing within Cyara.

• Work alongside one other Business Systems Analyst on the team, plus supporting engineers, in a fully individual-contributor capacity.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

• Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and system requirements, and translating them into technical specifications specific enough for developers to act on (e.g., which routing profile, queue, or quick connect needs to change).

• Working familiarity with Amazon Connect concepts - routing profiles, queues, quick connects, contact flows - enough to ask the right questions and write requirements a developer can implement without back-and-forth.

• Experience supporting testing/QA activities, including test case development and validation; comfort with (or openness to) automated testing is a plus.

• Experience documenting in JIRA and Confluence, or comparable tools.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between business and technical stakeholders and clearly hand off requirements to developers at varying experience levels.

Backed by elite Silicon Valley and European venture firms (including Y Combinator and Atomico), we recently closed a massive $13M+ Seed round to scale our global footprint.

If you thrive in high-autonomy environments, embrace ambiguity, and want true ownership over enterprise growth, this is your sandbox.

What We're Looking For

Why Join Us?

title: Quality Assurance
description:
Job Description:
We are Omnissa !

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, delivering flexible, secure, work-from-anywhere experiences. We integrate Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance into a seamless, autonomous workspace. Guided by our Core Values-Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value-we're growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact.
What is the opportunity?

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist to join our System Test under R&D. This high-visibility role is designed for a Subject Matter Expert (SME) at the intersection of Customer Success, Product Engineering, and Quality Strategy for the Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM platform. You will validate that our most complex cross-component workflows-including the growing Printer & IoT device management surface-are resilient, secure, and ready for global enterprise scale.
What You Will Do

•
Customer Flow Orchestration: Lead the “Customer Flow Program” by engaging with Support and Field teams to translate real-world customer use cases into comprehensive validation strategies.

•
Quality Strategy & SME Leadership: Define E2E Test Strategies for major features or architectural shifts, acting as the “Quality Gatekeeper” to eliminate blind spots.

•
Release Stewardship: Own release readiness for key UEM modules-overseeing test pipelines, risk assessment, and providing “Go/No-Go” technical confidence.

•
Continuous Enablement: Create technical playbooks and best-practice guides that empower Support and Solution Engineering teams.

•
Strategic Automation Advocacy: Influence the automation roadmap, leveraging AI-assisted tools and ensuring frameworks reflect real customer workflows.

•
Printer & IoT Fleet Validation: Own end-to-end quality for Workspace ONE's Printer & IoT device management capabilities across both the legacy connector model and the modern MQTT/AWS IoT architecture, from enrollment through decommissioning.

What We Are Looking For

•
UEM/MDM Depth: Deep architectural understanding of platforms like Workspace ONE, Intune, or JAMF-enrollment pipelines, policy engines, compliance state machines, certificate lifecycle, and OS-level MDM protocols.

•
Solution Mindset: Ability to understand how identity, endpoint security, and network configurations interact in hybrid-cloud environments.

•
Cross-Functional Influence: Track record of embedding testability and observability into product architecture during design.

•
Analytical & Communication Skills: Strong RCA skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both developers and customers.

Printer & IoT Management - Role-Specific Skills

•
Enrollment & MQTT Provisioning: Ability to validate printer enrollment via ZPL/OEM provisioning files and MQTT-based staging workflows across manufacturers (e.g., Zebra, and emerging support for Bixolon, Brother, Epson, Honeywell), including auto-discovery and bulk/wireless enrollment scenarios.

•
Certificate Lifecycle Testing: Experience validating device certificate issuance, auto-renewal against a configured Certificate Authority, delivery via AWS IoT, and revocation during un-enrollment (enterprise wipe) flows.

•
Firmware Management Validation: Ability to test firmware push/pull workflows delivered through MQTT or OEM connectors, including OTA-style updates that replace manual OEM tools (e.g., Zebra PPME).

•
Connector-to-MQTT Migration Testing: Familiarity with validating parity and migration paths between the legacy per-OEM connector architecture and the newer MQTT-based model, including device list view migration and backward compatibility.

•
Telemetry & Alerting Pipeline QA: Ability to verify printer/IoT device data (status, firmware version, error states, consumables) flows correctly into Workspace ONE Intelligence via the ETL pipeline, and that resulting alerts and dashboards are accurate.

title: Strategic Content Editor (Contract-to-Hire)
description:
The situation, honestly
Our content department head is going on a planned leave in the near future. Before that happens, we need a senior editor in place who can hold the line on strategy and quality while she's out, then keep raising the bar when she's back.
This starts as a contract role with a clear path to a full-time hire based on performance . We're not being coy about it: the leave is the reason for the speed, and the contract period is a working trial on both sides. If you do well, there's a permanent senior seat here with a benefits package.
Because of that timeline, we need someone who can ramp fast and operate independently. You'll get a real onboarding, documented strategy, and a team that knows what it's doing. You will not get six months to find your footing.
Who we are
RGX is a digital marketing agency built for home service businesses: HVAC, pest control, plumbing, electrical, and the trades that keep homes running.
Our clients are not hobby businesses. They’re doing $1.5M+ in annual revenue, investing in growth.
We help serious service businesses get clearer about what they offer, sharper about who they serve, and more direct about why a customer should choose them. Strategy first. Every sentence accountable to the business it serves.
What you'll actually do

• Review strategy before content exists. You'll read content briefs, keyword strategies, and funnel plans before writing starts, and pressure-test them. If the targeting is off, the search intent is misread, or the funnel logic doesn't hold, you catch it at the brief stage, not the draft stage.

• Edit for strategic alignment. Every draft gets checked against the strategy it was written to serve. You'll verify the copy matches the persona, the CTA fits the funnel stage, and the content actually satisfies the search intent we're targeting.

• Create editing standards where they don't exist. If you notice a recurring writing problem, a missing tone of voice guide, or a gap in our editorial process, you build the fix. You don't wait to be asked, and you don't file it as someone else's problem. You do pause long enough to get leadership and team buy-in, because a standard only works if the people using it helped shape it. Fix what's broken, and fix it with the team rather than around them.

• Spot ranking opportunities the brief missed. You read SERPs, not just drafts. If a piece could capture a featured snippet with a structural change, or a related keyword cluster is sitting there unclaimed, you flag it and adjust.

• Run quality control. You're the last set of eyes before content ships. Clarity, flow, tone, accuracy, brand voice, and the unglamorous stuff like internal links, metadata, and formatting. You'll help formalize our QA process so quality doesn't depend on any one person being in the room.

• Give writers feedback that makes them better. Direct, specific, actionable notes that explain the strategic reasoning, not just the correction. Our writers are good. Your job is to make them sharper.

Requirements
Where this goes
This role exists because our content department is growing faster than one director can quality-control. The interim coverage is the immediate need. The real opportunity is what comes after.
The person who succeeds here will help build the editorial function itself: the standards, the QA program, the feedback systems that let a team scale without quality slipping. As the department grows, this seat is positioned to grow into a leadership role, including mentoring and eventually managing editors. You'll be learning team leadership directly from the content director, with real responsibility from week one rather than a title and a waiting period.
If you're a senior editor who has hit the ceiling at your current job, this is the next rung.
Who does well in this role

• 5+ years editing strategic marketing content (SEO content, landing pages, email, PPC assets) in an agency or similar fast-moving environment. You've edited for performan

This role is responsible for managing proposal timelines, organizing requirements, identifying content gaps, coordinating input from SMEs, and producing clear, client-focused content.

title: Senior Infrastructure / DX Engineer – Platform (all genders)
description:
ABOUT BABBEL LABS

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We are an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, research and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.

THE ROLE

We are modernising and consolidating our services in the cloud, and we are building the internal platform that lets product teams ship and run those services with confidence. This role builds that platform. It also stays close to the code, in the same cloud-native, TypeScript and Node stack the product teams use.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on the Platform team. You will design, build and ship, and you will work directly with product engineers to help them solve their infrastructure problems.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

- Build and operate the internal developer platform, the paved road of tooling and infrastructure that lets teams set up and run their own services without waiting on us.

- Drive our cloud migration, moving and consolidating services into a modern cloud-native setup without slowing delivery.

- Design system and infrastructure architecture and communicate it clearly, including diagrams that other engineers can build from.

- Work alongside product engineers and get them unblocked, because the platform exists to serve the product.

- Deliver with coding agents as a matter of course, and help improve how the whole team does so.

YOUR SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- Strong, hands-on cloud engineering experience on AWS at organisational scale: multi-account setups, identity and access, networking, and account-level guardrails. Serverless is our default but we want someone who can pick the right tool for each problem.

- A security-first instinct: least privilege, secrets management, and treating patching and vulnerability remediation as routine work.

- Deep, hands-on experience with infrastructure as code. You have built and maintained real production estates in Terraform, or a close equivalent, and you are comfortable owning delivery pipelines on AWS.

- TypeScript on Node.js as your primary application language, or a deliberate and recent move to it. Python is a welcome secondary. Go or Rust are useful for performance-critical components.

- A track record of building or choosing internal tooling that lets other engineers work faster, with the judgement to adopt an existing solution when one fits rather than build from scratch.

- Delivery experience in both lean startup settings and larger organisations, with ownership from start to finish. You scope a sensible first version and build on it.

- Coding agents are part of your daily workflow, and you check their output before you rely on it. You are neither dismissive of them nor careless with them.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with monorepo build systems and shared tooling.

- Previous cloud-migration work.

- A track record of building internal command-line tools or code generators.

- Public technical work, such as open-source contributions or writing.

WAYS OF WORKING

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small platform team that works agent-first. It is remote and Berlin-friendly. The interview process is deliberately short. It is an initial screen, followed by one structured working session with the hiring manager.

About the role

Sardine is looking for a Head of Talent & People to lead and grow our global team. This is a hands-on, player-coach role - you'll set direction and manage a full team of practitioners, while still staying close enough to the work to source a hard-to-fill candidate yourself, sit in on a tough employee relations conversation, or dig into a comp band directly. You'll own Talent, People Ops, and HR Business Partnering end-to-end, with a mandate to build pragmatic systems that scale with a fast-growing startup.

title: Head of Partner Programs, Strategy and Operations
description:
Apollo .io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo .io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo .io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As the Head of Partner Operations, you will build and own the operating system that allows Apollo 's Partnerships business to scale. Sitting within Revenue Operations, you will be the connective tissue between partner strategy and the company-wide systems, data, processes, and commercial infrastructure that make partner motions work.
This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Systems, Data, Finance, Legal. Partner Managers own relationships and execution; you own the operational infrastructure underneath them and you’ll help co-author our partner strategy. You'll establish the metrics and reporting that leadership uses to understand partner performance, architect the processes and systems that support different partner motions, and ensure the commercial mechanics behind those motions work reliably.
You'll operate across Apollo 's technology, agency, integration, and strategic partner ecosystem. The goal isn't simply to make today's processes run better. It's to build a scalable Partner Operations function that can absorb new partner motions, eliminate operational friction, and give the business a clear understanding of where partnerships are creating revenue and where the model needs to evolve.
The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to build a function, not inherit a playbook.
Partnerships is becoming an increasingly important part of Apollo 's revenue ecosystem, but partner motions create a unique operational challenge: the work crosses organizational boundaries, the data often lives across multiple systems, and the right operating model changes as the business learns.
The Head of Partner Operations will be responsible for turning that complexity into leverage. You'll help define how Apollo measures partner impact, how partner motions are structured, how systems support them, and how the company can scale partner revenue without scaling operational overhead at the same rate.
The strongest person in this role will leave the Partnerships organization with something substantially better than they found it: a clear operating model, trusted data, scalable systems, reliable commercial mechanics, and a set of partner motions that can evolve without rebuilding the infrastructure from scratch.

What We Expect of You:

• Bachelor's degree and 3 years of Microsoft support experience, or 7 years of total IT engineering experience, including 3 years of Microsoft support experience.

• Hands-on experience supporting Microsoft technologies, with strong knowledge of Azure.

• Experience supporting one or more related technologies, such as Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory, SCCM, or Intune.

• Professional experience in customer service, requirements gathering, task execution, troubleshooting, problem solving, and sound judgment around crisis escalation.

• Experience working in a ticket-driven or case-based support environment.

• Ability to establish customer trust and confidence through technical knowledge, responsiveness, and an understanding of customer business needs.

• Strong organizational, analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers, coworkers, and stakeholders.

• Own conversion rate optimization (CRO) across the funnel - homepage, product/pricing pages, cart, checkout, and post-purchase - with a specific focus on reducing cart abandonment and friction at the point of purchase.

• Document best practices and repeatable playbooks for personalization and cart conversion that can scale across customer segments and verticals.

• Leverage AI-driven tools to improve testing velocity, personalization targeting, and content generation for on-site experiences.

• 4-6 years of experience in eCommerce, digital marketing, growth, or CRO, with hands-on personalization and testing experience.

• Proven success driving both acquisition conversion and upsell/cross-sell revenue in a B2B SaaS or self-serve, product-led growth environment.

• Strong understanding of customer segmentation, behavioral targeting, and the eCommerce funnel from acquisition through expansion.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, run statistically sound A/B tests, and translate findings into action.

• Experience with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics, and familiarity with a MarTech/CRM stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).

• Strategic thinker with a bias for action and a passion for continuous optimization.

title: Litigation Counsel
description:

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Legal team is looking for an experienced litigator to join our Litigation and Regulatory team. You'll manage a broad docket of litigation files and pre-litigation disputes with a high degree of autonomy, advise the business on litigation risk, and help build the systems and processes that let a growing litigation function operate well at scale.

The matters you'll handle span intellectual property (particularly copyright), class actions, commercial disputes, and could include securities and shareholder disputes, in both first-party and third-party matters, in the U.S. and abroad. You'll partner closely with colleagues across Legal and teams throughout the company to resolve matters thoughtfully and with minimal disruption to the business. You may also support regulatory investigations and inquiries as needed.

Key responsibilities

• Manage a broad range of litigation matters that could include intellectual property (particularly copyright) matters, class actions, regulatory and commercial disputes, and securities cases

• Direct outside counsel across all stages of litigation, from pre-suit response through discovery, dispositive briefing, trial or resolution and appeal, with a focus on strategic decision-making and filing excellent legal briefs

• Manage small disputes and escalations to limit business friction and minimize risk

• Advise company leadership and cross-functional partners on litigation risk, and develop appropriate strategic litigation plans, including matter-resolution proposals

• Design and implement processes, policies, and tools that help the litigation and regulatory team handle matters efficiently and at scale, such as matter intake, outside counsel budgeting, contingency reporting, and pre-litigation escalation run books

title: Chief Product & Technology Officer
description:
About Nira Energy

• Nira's mission is to help convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free.

• We are profitable!

• Nira is a software platform that helps renewable energy developers find the cheapest points on the grid to connect.

• We focus on estimating the cost to interconnect with the electrical grid (aka the Interconnection Process). Depending on where developers connect, they may be on the hook to pay millions of dollars to upgrade power lines, substations etc.

About The Company

• Our mission is to convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free and do our part in combating climate change

• The electric grid is one of the largest bottlenecks standing between us and a clean energy future. Our software helps transmission engineers plan the grid in a faster, more economic, and more reliable manner

• We are the market leader in tranmission software and are currently used by >100 of the most sophisticated engineering teams in the country

• We are on a path to 5x’ing our revenue as we continue to rapidly scale with both our existing customers and into new markets

• We’ve been profitable since inception and have a highly unique financial profile. We aren’t subject to the traditional VC funding cycles and are anticipating material liquidity events for equity owners in the company

• This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join a company that is positioned to have a massive impact on climate change, coupled with extremely high financial upside for the leaders that help bring these products to market

About The Role

This role will sit parallel to our co-founder and Chief Transmission Officer, Andrew, who is one of the foremost transmission planners in the industry. Andrew will be responsible for high level product vision and will serve as our SME on where the industry is heading.

The CPTO will be responsible for turning that vision into a sequenced roadmap and leading the team responsible for building those products.

The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning, and our Product Managers will report to the CPTO. For context, the Transmission Planning team works hand in hand with the software engineering team to write the code needed to generate our data. The organization is currently ~17 people with 2 Product Managers, 7 Software Engineers, and 8 Transmission Planners.

Ultimately, the CPTO will be the founders technical operating partner, responsible for translating customer insights into products as we scale to $50M+ ARR.

The ideal candidate is an executive with a strong track record of building high performing teams and world class products. You’ve ideally held a prominent role at an early stage startup, i.e $50M in revenue and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led there as well.

What you'll own

• Delivery and execution: You're the single point of accountability for how the product and engineering organization performs against its weekly, quarterly, and annual goals

• Product Decisions: You’ll partner with Andrew to set the product vision / roadmap direction and will ultimately be responsible for ensuring the team is making product decisions that increase revenue and retention

• People Leadership: The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning and the Product Managers will report to you. You’ll be responsible for managing their growth and performance and getting the organization to work as one smooth efficient machine.

• Operating Engine: You’ll be responsible for building the systems, processes and cadences to make product delivery predictable and efficient as we scale

What we're looking for

• A proven track record of building a high performing product team and executive leadership. You have led one or multiple product organizations and former reports regard you as a A+ leader that they’d join again in a heartbeat

• A proven track record of building successful products. You’ve led one or many product initiatives that have delivered material customer value

- Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

- Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing.

- Familiarity with core data concepts such as data modeling, data governance, and data engineering best practices.

- Hands-on expertise with Python and SQL.

 

OUR VALUES. OUR CULTURE.

 

We are customer-obsessed. We lead with integrity and honesty. We believe in being great teammates, embracing feedback, and embodying the Snowflake values in every interaction. We work to ensure data is accessible, usable, and valuable to everyone.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team?
At Sprout Social , our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.
In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.
What You'll Do
As Manager, Customer Success, Strategic, you will lead a team of tenured Strategic Customer Success Managers overseeing a high value book of business. Your focus is bringing segment strategy to life with operational rigor, ensuring repeatable team execution, and driving retention and portfolio growth.

•
Lead & Develop Senior Talent: Direct and coach an experienced team of CSMs through 1:1s, call reviews, and account planning. Build individualized growth paths, clear operational roadblocks, and set clear performance expectations.

Establish and refine team operating standards-including Mutual Success Plans, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), account health scoring, and CRM discipline - to ensure consistent performance across the portfolio.

•

•
Lead Through Change & Cross-Functional Alignment: Guide the team through evolving go-to-market motions with clarity. Partner with Sales, Renewals, Onboarding, and Product to unblock technical hurdles and advocate for customer needs internally.

•
Monitor & Report Performance: Track and report key metrics across retention, growth, adoption, and health scores to diagnose portfolio trends and optimize resource allocation.

What You'll Bring
The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader who thrives on operational discipline and is energized by complex, high-stakes customer relationships. You bring strong business acumen, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for the work-staying motivated and forward-looking through ambiguity and difficult stretches, and bringing your team with you.
Minimum qualifications:

•
Customer Success Experience: 6+ years in Customer Success or account management, with direct experience owning a strategic or enterprise book of business.

•
People Leadership: 1+ years of experience leading client-facing teams, with a track record of coaching, performance management, and developing high-tenured individual contributors serving matrixed enterprise clients.

•
Commercial & Operational Track Record: Proven success driving retention and growth targets, paired with strong business acumen across renewals, nego

Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62 K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

S'more about the team:

The Product Innovation team is looking for a Sourcing Manager, Canadian New Ingredients to own the commercial and operational side of bringing new ingredients to HelloFresh. Supporting the Canadian Product team, you are accountable for the full journey of an innovation ingredient - from finding the perfect supplier, negotiation and onboarding, to a live SKU in our boxes.
Where the broader product team identifies what ingredients we should pursue, you are responsible for making them happen. You engage suppliers, negotiate the terms, and own the end-to-end process that takes a new ingredient from opportunity to operational reality - fast. Communicate ingredient specifications clearly, coordinate sample submissions, and manage supplier relationships through the evaluation process. You set the tone for new supplier relationships from day one and remain the primary point of contact through onboarding.

• Commercial Relationships: Own the full scope of commercial terms with innovation ingredient suppliers, including pricing, volume commitments, supply agreements, payment terms, exclusivity arrangements, and brand partnership structures such as co-marketing programs or product-for-placement deals. You understand what a sound commercial arrangement looks like across all of these dimensions and you negotiate terms that work for HelloFresh while building durable supplier relationships. For RFP and standard SKU processes, you provide support through approvals navigation and sensory inputs. Nothing launches without your sign-off on the supplier and commercial side.

• SKU Approvals: Steward new new ingredient SKUs through the HelloFresh approval processes. Coordinate across Procurement, Operations, and FSQA to ensure all approvals, specifications, and data requirements are complete before launch. You sequence the work across teams to prevent bottlenecks and keep innovation ingredients on track.

• Post-Launch Review: Track how new ingredients perform after launch across quality, customer feedback, and operational metrics. Flag underperforming ingredients early, lead corrective action where needed, and close the loop on every ingredient you brought in. Performance data informs what the team pursues next.

• All other duties, as assigned.

• 5+ years of experience in ingredient sourcing, procurement, or food innovation within CPG, food service, or a related industry - with a demonstrated track record of managing supplier relationships and commercial negotiations.
